title: Balancing Act: Prioritization Strategies for LLM-Designed Restless Bandit Rewards

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating policy execution in a Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) environment to compute the utility (resource allocation) generated for different income and education groups, and measuring unintended utility shifts using Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) between candidate and default reward distributions.

Simulating policy execution in a Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) environment to compute the utility generated for different age groups, and evaluating unintended utility drops or shifts using Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) when prioritizing other demographic features.
